hook_text: A whole term of electronics on one wall. Walk along it in sixty seconds.
clip_script: Circuits: a complete loop, standard symbols, dots at joins. Series shares the volts, parallel shares the current. Series switches are AND, parallel switches are OR. Ohm's law: volts across, amps in line, V equals I times R if nothing heats up. Straight line through zero, gradient is the resistance. LED resistor: supply minus 2, over the current. Components: diode one way, LED lights and needs a resistor, yellow violet brown is 470, count poles and throws, transistor lets a trickle control a flood, LDR drops in light, thermistor drops in heat, capacitor stores for ohms times farads seconds. Four traps: backwards parts, no base resistor, sensors driving loads, explanations without jobs.
visual_style: Whiteboard wall of small diagrams in a row with a one-line rule under each, the camera panning along; four red crosses at the end.
mood: Brisk and reassuring, like a final walk-through.
pacing: Circuits, logic, Ohm, graph, LED sum, components one by one, traps.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write the one-line rule for each of the term's twelve components.
